Definition: Whether the country has an operational Internet Exchange Point (IXP) and its maturity. IXPs enable local internet traffic to be exchanged domestically rather than being routed internationally, reducing latency, costs, and dependence on foreign infrastructure. Critical for local digital ecosystem development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed and corroborated: EG-IX (built with Telecom Egypt and AMS-IX inside the Smart Village Tier III facility) is active with a substantial and growing member list including Vodafone Egypt, Etisalat Misr, Telecom Egypt/TE Data, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Huawei Cloud. This supports at least code 4 (active, moderate participation); evidence of traffic volumes would be needed to justify code 5 ('mature ecosystem'), so the score is confirmed at 4.

Comments: Sectoral for classified data Cloud First Policy
